messages:
maria: Quick sync — Nebula partnership: we committed to a joint benchmark blog + webinar. Need an ops runthrough for launch posts, routing, and comms. TL;DR: webinar on Mon 4/18, benchmark blog on 4/20, short social push on 4/21.
jake: 👍 timeline looks ok. main asks: 1) landing page + CTA, 2) benchmark data tables, 3) SDR routing for marketplace signups.
sarah: I'll take the landing page copy and the social snippets. Draft 1 by Thu EOD?
maria: Yes. Keep messaging focused on "predictable latency + 30% cost savings in our test" — can't overclaim. Use qualifier: "in our benchmark workload".
devin: From partner side (Nebula) — we can supply the model runner logs and a summary CSV. I'll share `nebula-bench-2026.csv` in the drive.
liam: Ops note: inbound leads from Nebula marketplace need to hit SFDC Campaign -> "Nebula Syndication 2026" and tag origin=nebula_marketplace. Also create Zap to route to #sdr-triage.
maria: Sarah, make sure the CTA on the landing page is `Request dedicated trial` (maps to trial flow). Jake, please confirm analytics goal: track conversion from marketplace -> trial.
jake: Confirmed. Tracking plan: set UTM utm_source=nebula, utm_campaign=nebula-synd-0426, and set hidden field `partner_tracking=NEB-0426`. I'll post the GA/GTM snippet later.
sarah: Draft social: \"Nebula + Redwood Inference: faster serving, lower token cost. Watch our benchmark + demo 4/18. Register: <lp_link>\" Short thread + 3 cards. I'll keep tone technical but not dense.
maria: Webinar format: 25m talk (product + partner), 20m live demo, 15m Q&A. Need a rehearsals slot next Wed 4/10. Devin can run demo environment.
devin: I'll prepare a short script and a reproducible `docker run` snippet for demo. Demo artifact: `docker run nebula/demo:bench-v2 --port 8080`.
liam: Routing details for SDRs: create SFDC auto-assignment rule for leads where origin=nebula_marketplace to queue `sdr-integrations`. Within the queue, tag `lead_type=marketplace` and priority=medium. Ops to create in SF by Mon.
maria: Messaging iterations: 1) headline — "Predictable inference, 30% lower token cost (benchmark)" 2) subhead — quick methodology note 3) CTA. Sarah, prefer 3 headline variants by Fri.
sarah: Got it. Will A/B test headline A vs B in the landing page for first 48h.
jake: Lead scoring: marketplace leads with company size > 50 and usage intent = trial get SLA 24h from SDRs. Will add to playbook.
liam: Also add a retention rule: if user signs up via Nebula marketplace and triggers >10k tokens in first 7 days, alert growth@redwood for offer to convert to Dedicated.
maria: Content calendar: Webinar invite (email) 4/1, social teaser 4/10, webinar 4/18, benchmark post 4/20, roundup blog + transcript 4/27. Please add any dependencies.
devin: Dependency: Nebula legal needs to sign co-marketing agreement by 4/3. I pinged legal today.
maria: If legal misses 4/3 we'll punt public benchmark to 4/27 but keep internal dry-run.
ops-bot: Reminder set: rehearsal -> 1764000000 (calendar invite created).
jake: Action items recap: Sarah (lp + social + headline variants), Maria (webinar host + partner comms), Devin (demo + bench CSV + legal follow), Liam (SF/DC routing + zap), me (tracking + GTM snippet + lead scoring). I'll create a GH checklist and link it to the thread.
sarah: One more: can we prewrite an FAQ for the webinar? I'll draft 8 Qs based on usual marketplace questions.
maria: Perfect. Final ask — short copy blocks for engineering audience and product audience. Keep both ready for PR/partners. Meeting to finalize Friday 4/5 10am PT.
liam: Noted. Adding to calendar.
maria: Thanks team — milestone: no public comms until legal signoff AND landing page live with tracking. We'll reconvene after drafts. :thumbsup:
